name: Reason Machines
long_description:
Reason runs autonomous cloud agents with a frontier harness on cost per task.

It delivers the same performance with 30-50% lower costs than other harnesses. By operating with a harness outside the sandbox, it acts seamlessly across cloud computers and local devices.

Reason runs work from start to finish: from an issue to a finished pull request, on a schedule, or from a Slack alert. It is available as a Mac app, on the web, from the CLI, in Slack, and through a REST API, with about 100 integrations and shareable skills. Bring your own keys and subscriptions, and work rolls over to the next one when limits are hit.
one_liner: Reason is world's most effective agent on cost per task

launches.title: Reason: the most efficient agent harness
launches.tagline: Run hundreds of parallel sessions across cloud VMs using your own keys and subscriptions at 30-80% lower cost
launches.body:
Hey everyone, we’re Adi and Sven, co-founders of Reason Machines 👋

**TL;DR** We built the most efficient agent harness, so teams can maximize their AI usage at up to 30-80% lower cost per task than Codex, Cursor, or Devin. Sessions run on cloud VMs that move across your devices, use your existing keys and subscriptions, and work directly in Slack.

Since launching 4 weeks ago: **20,000 users**, **14,000 X followers**, and **3M+ impressions**.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LVRSTgnaexg>

---

## Problem

AI models are finally good enough for real work. The bottleneck is no longer capability—it’s cost: how much work you get per dollar of inference.

That cost is set by the harness more than the model: the same model can cost up to 5× more depending on the harness. Today, teams are stuck choosing between simple chat bots that can’t touch infrastructure, and closed cloud platforms that lock you into one vendor’s models and markup.

---

## Solution

We designed a minimal harness for the most work per token, with the power of a cloud VM and the ease of a personal bot:

* **Cloud VMs that follow you:** Runs across cloud Linux, cloud Mac, local machines, or SSH boxes without losing state.
* **Swarm-scale parallelism:** Run hundreds of sessions in parallel to ship a feature, or let workflows run for days.
* **BYO keys & subscriptions:** Plug in your API keys, open weights, and Grok, Copilot, or Kimi subscriptions with auto-failover.
* **Slack-native:** Mention @Reason in a thread to get back a PR, a deck, or an answer.

---

## The harness

A minimal harness (bash + async code execution) beats labs' bloated harnesses on cost per task without sacrificing capability. On the Coding Agent Index, Reason scored **65.1 vs Codex’s 62.5**, at **22% lower cost per solved task**. Read the [full benchmark write-up](https://reasonmachines.com/blog/introducing-reason-agent-1-1).

![Coding Agent Index against cost per task, with Reason highest at about $4 per task, beside a comparison of Reason finishing a task in 3 model calls and a call-per-tool harness in 7](/media/?type=post&id=128746&key=user_uploads/3131989/e05783ce-ae24-4e0a-adf3-ec631ee6f965)

---

## Team

Adi and Sven studied EECS at UC Berkeley. Adi worked in applied ML at Scale AI and previously built a Rust-based IDE; Sven built AI models at a Fortune 100 company. 

**More AI usage, for less cost.**

![Adi and Sven, cofounders of Reason Machines](/media/?type=post&id=128746&key=user_uploads/3131989/d3d601dc-1b55-4959-9b8b-83f57b071b17)

---

## Our ask

* **Try it:** [start on the web](https://reasonmachines.com/login) or add @Reason to Slack. YC companies get $1,000 in credits via our Deal.
* **Intros:** We’d love intros to teams hitting AI usage limits or paying heavy bills for Codex, Cursor, or Devin.
* **Investors:** We’re raising our seed round—reach us at [founders@reasonmachines.com](mailto:founders@reasonmachines.com).

launches.title: Ara - The World's First Self-driving IDE
launches.tagline: The IDE that thinks ahead of you
launches.body:
Hey everyone, we’re [Adi](https://www.linkedin.com/in/adisinghlink/) and [Sven](https://www.linkedin.com/in/svemy/) - cofounders of [Ara](https://ara.so/) 👋\
\
**tl;dr:** we built an IDE for the future

<https://youtu.be/6ASb9QW2QEw>\
\
**the problem**\
The bottleneck in development keeps moving. It used to be writing the code. Then agents solved that, and it became reviewing the code. Now what's left is planning the next step, and every IDE still waits.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102348&key=user_uploads/3131989/cb840d79-95f8-446d-b4cd-a60e9db72a85)

**the solution** \
Ara closes the loop. It proactively plans your next step, handing you proposals you can discard or send off to follow up on, with self-improving memory across all your tools and sessions, and full visibility across chats, files, browsers, terminals, and review panes.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102348&key=user_uploads/3131989/fc09658e-c84b-4e56-8b00-4485c3de72ae)

\
**team**\
Adi and Sven both studied EECS at UC Berkeley. Adi worked in applied ML, at Scale AI and previously built an IDE company. Sven was an ML engineer on production systems and chaired Norway's largest student AI org. Serial hackathon winners, they've built and lived together across four cities and dropped out to build the IDE they always wanted.

The goal is an IDE that runs the development loop end to end, not one that waits for instructions.

\
_The IDE for token-maxxers._

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102348&key=user_uploads/3131989/eb3b255b-1cc1-4f77-a1c5-aa2f22227b7b)

**our ask**\
Try it! [**Download Ara**](https://ara.so/) and email us at [founders@ara.so](mailto:founders@ara.so) with your feedback.
